ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory identification and ongoing monitoring of domestic and foreign Politically Exposed Persons (including family members and close associates) under Circular Externa 100-000005/2021, with enhanced due diligence, source-of-funds analysis and compliance-officer approval. All UBOs, shareholders, representatives and counterparties must be screened against the OFAC SDN list, the UN Security Council Consolidated List, UK HMT sanctions, and Colombian national lists (UIAF 'Listas Nacionales e Internacionales', Procuraduria/Contraloria debarment lists). Screening is performed at onboarding and repeated annually on a risk-based continuous monitoring basis.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RUES - Registro Unico Empresarial y Social (www.rues.org.co), with name pre-approval (certificado de homonimia) lodged through the competent Camara de Comercio (e.g., Camara de Comercio de Bogota)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All corporate names must be registered in Spanish (Castilian) using Latin-script characters. Foreign-language descriptive terms must appear in Spanish translation, except for recognized proper nouns, technical terms or internationally accepted abbreviations. Names in non-Latin scripts are transliterated and a Spanish translation is attached to the RUES filing. The S.A.S. name must include the acronym 'S.A.S.'
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Banco, Bancario, Ahorro (requires Superintendencia Financiera authorization)
Seguros, Aseguradora, Reaseguradora (requires Superintendencia Financiera authorization)
Bolsa, Comisionista de Bolsa (requires Superintendencia Financiera authorization)
Cooperativa (requires Superintendencia de la Economia Solidaria authorization)
IPS, EPS, Clinica, Hospital (requires Ministry of Health authorization)
Universidad, Colegio (requires Ministry of Education authorization)
Palabras que induzcan a error sobre forma social, objeto, tipo o denomina
statutory_name_clearance_protocol._comment: The schema token indicates prior ministerial approval as the required standard; the above tokens reflect the Colombian statutory framework.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection by the Camara de Comercio, the incorporator may (i) file a new name request at no additional cost, or (ii) submit a 'recurso de reposicion' to the same Chamber within 10 business days and a subsidiary 'recurso de apelacion' before the Superintendencia de Sociedades under Law 1437 of 2011 (Articles 74-80). The Chamber is required to resolve within 30 business days; filing up to three alternative names in parallel is permitted to mitigate administrative delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Acceptable for initial registration and tax domicile of the S.A.S., provided a physical Colombian address for legal notifications is registered with the Camara de Comercio. For a low-risk localization agency, a shared serviced office or registered-agent address is permitted; however, a virtual-office-only arrangement may be disfavored for corporate bank account opening and may attract substance scrutiny under the SAGRILAFT risk profile.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low (estimated <=10% probability within the first three fiscal years). Unannounced physical inspections are uncommon for non-licensed professional services; formal inspections are triggered primarily by risk signals such as irregular UBO reporting, invoicing anomalies, or SAGRILAFT deficiencies.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Ley 1258 de 2008, Articles 1-5, 17, 22-27 and 40-49 (S.A.S. constitution, capital, governance and dissolution); Código de Comercio, Decreto-Ley 410 de 1971, Articles 110-115 and 156-161 (merchant registration and corporate records); Decreto 1074 de 2015, Titles 2.2.1 and 2.2.2 (Chamber registration rules and RUES); Resolución 100-000005 de 2023 (beneficial-owner filings); Ley 222 de 1995 (audit and minority rights).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Cámara de Comercio of the corporate domicile (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) through the Registro Único Empresarial y Social (RUES), jointly with DIAN for tax pre-registration and the Superintendencia de Sociedades for beneficial-ownership reporting.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Documento Privado de Constitución (private incorporation instrument) authenticated before a notary or Chamber official, registered in the Registro Mercantil and evidenced by the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up or subscribed capital applicable: an S.A.S. may be incorporated with zero or nominal capital. Subscribed capital may be paid in up to two (2) years from incorporation per Article 17 of Law 1258 of 2008; in-kind contributions must be described in the incorporation instrument, and a public deed is mandatory when real property is contributed.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the subscribers accept the shares issued under the incorporation by-laws, covering the full subscribed capital, and approve the payment schedule for paid-in contributions as stated therein; (2) that the Company's registered office be, and is hereby, fixed at [city, municipality and address], Colombia, in accordance with the statutory-domicile clause; (3) that [Name] be appointed Legal Representative and [Name] Alternate Legal Representative, with the powers set out in the by-laws, and [Name] auditor only if required by law; (4) that the Legal Representative is expressly authorized to complete the commercial registration with the Chamber of Commerce, the DIAN tax registration (NIT/RUT), and every municipal or sectoral permit required; and (5) that this resolution be recorded in the corporate minute book.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social — RUES online portal (https://www.rues.org.co)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the RUES 'Consulta de nombres' module and submit up to three proposed corporate names for the S.A.S. Obtain the Certificado de Homonimia (valid 30 calendar days, renewable) evidencing the absence of identical or confusingly similar registered names.
required_dossiers: RUES name-search request
Identification documents of the founding shareholders
Filing voucher of the search fee
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a conflicting name is found, file a written reconsideration with the Cámara de Comercio explaining the differentiating elements of the proposed name, or request approval of the next name on the submitted list; the registry resolves within two business days at no additional charge.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution and Authentication of the Incorporation Instrument
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Founding shareholders (comparecencia) or Notaría Pública (authentication optional; mandatory only if real property is contributed)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Documento Privado de Constitución per Article 5 of Law 1258 of 2008 containing identity of shareholders, domicile, corporate purpose (CIIU 7490: translation, interpretation, localization and media dubbing), subscribed capital and payment terms, share classes, board and representation rules, and liquidation provisions. Have signatures authenticated by a notary or Chamber official. If real estate is contributed, execute an Escritura Pública before a notary.
required_dossiers: Private incorporation instrument meeting the statutory clauses
Certificado de homonimia in force
Valid passports or national ID (Cédula) of all shareholders
Proof of signature authentication or notarial fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Chamber later observes a formal defect, the shareholders sign an amending and clarifying deed (Corrección al Documento de Constitución) and re-file the same application within fifteen business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Registration, RUT Pre-Registration and Corporate Books Endorsement at the Chamber of Commerce (RUES single window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Cámara de Comercio del domicilio social (e.g., Cámara de Comercio de Bogotá) via RUES
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upload the authenticated incorporation instrument, the PRE-RUT form, and the request for endorsement of the shareholder registry book and minutes book (Registro de Libros) into the RUES single window. Pay the registration and form fees. Upon approval, the Chamber issues the Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal, assigns a provisional NIT, and electronically transmits the tax data to DIAN.
required_dossiers: Incorporation instrument (authenticated original)
PRE-RUT form completed online
Certificado de homonimia
Payment receipts for inscription fees
Commercial establishment information form if a physical office is registered on the same act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: The Chamber grants a 30-day term for formal corrections; the company re-files the corrected pages with a letter of clarification and pays only the balance of inscription fees, if any; the registration date backdates to the initial filing date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: DIAN Definitive NIT, RUT Update and Electronic Invoicing Enablement
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales) — MUISCA platform
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Within ten business days following commercial registration, update the provisional RUT electronically (MUISCA) to confirm the definitive NIT, registration address, CIIU activity 7490 and the tax regime (general income tax; VAT-responsible general regime). Apply for authorization to issue electronic invoices (facturación electrónica) and electronic payroll documents.
required_dossiers: RUT update form (Formulario e-RUT)
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
Lease or ownership title of the registered office
ID of the legal representative and accountant if appointed
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If DIAN requires a domicile site inspection, attend with the lease contract and the latest utility bill; if the system blocks the RUT for an inconsistent address, submit the 'Solicitud de Actualización del RUT' attaching the updated commercial registry certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Superintendencia de Sociedades (through RUES / SE-III web service)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Determine whether the company meets either threshold (total assets exceeding 5,000 UVT or gross income exceeding 3,000 UVT) requiring mandatory RUB filing. If below threshold, record a board minute stating non-application. If above threshold, identify all natural persons holding 5% or more equity or control and file the corresponding schedule under Resolution 100-000005 of 2023 in the month following commercial registration.
required_dossiers: RUB identifier form and single beneficiaries schedule
Control-chain narrative for each interposed entity
Certified copies of beneficial owners' identification
Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a filing deficiency notice is issued, resubmit the schedule with a complete control-chain description within ten business days, or correct data of record through the RUES portal before the annual refresh deadline.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Bank Account Opening and Payroll/Social Security (PILA) Enrollment
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed financial institutions and social security operators (PILA / EPS / ARL / AFP)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open the corporate account in the company's name with the final NIT, the Certificado de Existencia, the appointment minutes and the by-laws, under standard KYC procedures applicable to the low-risk professional services tier. Register the company as an employer and enrol the legal representative and staff with an EPS (health), AFP (pension), ARL (occupational risk) and parafiscal contributions (SENA/ICBF/Comfamiliar), paying the first PILA dues.
required_dossiers: Certificado de Existencia y Representación Legal (issued within the last 30 days)
Definitive NIT / RUT
Certified copy of by-laws and appointment minutes
Beneficial-ownership information for bank KYC
Bank forms and signature cards
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the application for KYC gaps, resubmit with updated certificates and a letter describing the professional services activity (low risk); if a PILA payment fails, request the operator to reprocess and pay any surcharge within the same payroll period.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio (SIC) for consumer, IP and market matters; Dirección de Cinematografía (Ministerio de Cultura) only for optional cinematic dubbing registration; no case-by-case industrial license applies to ISIC 7490.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable. The activity is exercised through the Matrícula Mercantil and RUT with CIIU code 7490 (translation and interpretation); audiovisual dubbing for cinema exhibition optionally requires registration with the Dirección de Cinematografía under Ley 814 de 2003, but localization of non-cinema media content (e-learning, corporate video, software) requires no prior authorization.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Secretaría Distrital/Unidad de Planeación Municipal de Medio Ambiente (local authority) and ANLA only when the activity exceeds horizontal Decreto 1076 de 2015 thresholds
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt from EIA. Office-based translation and dubbing fall outside the Article 2.2.2.3.2.3 list of Decreto 1076 de 2015 requiring an environmental license; only a non-domestic hazardous waste management plan is required if the site generates more than 10 kg/month of such waste (toners, UPS batteries) per Decreto 4741 de 2005 and Resolución 1362 de 2007.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharge. Sewer connections must meet domestic wastewater provisions of Resolución 2115 de 2007; hazardous residues (lamps per Resolución 1512 de 2010, computers per Resolución 1672 de 2013) must be delivered to reverse-logistics programs; workplace VOC and noise in dubbing booths must remain under the 2023 Colombian occupational exposure limits and Resolution 2400 de 1979 (Title VIII).

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Certificado de Bomberos (fire safety inspection of exits, extinguishers and alarms); Concepto de Uso de Suelo (land-use compatibility certificate from the municipal planning authority); SG-SST implementation evidence under Resolución 0312 de 2019; binding ARL affiliation and Reglamento de Higiene y Seguridad Industrial; plus municipal acoustic-impact clearance for the recording/dubbing suite if located in mixed-use zones of Bogotá, Cali or Medellín.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales (DIAN) - National Tax and Customs Directorate; official portal: www.dian.gov.co; transactional e-services platform (MUISCA): muisca.dian.gov.co; electronic invoicing clearance: fe.dian.gov.co.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Colombian SAS obtains its NIT (Número de Identificación Tributaria) through the RUT (Registro Único Tributario). Foreign shareholders must appoint a Colombian legal representative, formalize incorporation before the Cámara de Comercio, then apply online via MUISCA or a certified OFE (authorized e-invoicing provider). DIAN validates existence, address and economic activity codes (ISIC 7490 assigned to the RUT), issues the definitive NIT with verification digit (DV), and grants the electronic-invoicing authorization (Habilitación de Facturación Electrónica) plus the digital certificate required for monthly VAT and annual income tax filings. Non-resident entities without local activity may obtain a simplified NIT through a fiscal proxy for withholding-tax compliance.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation / Territorial_Scope - a resident SAS is taxed at the corporate income rate (35% for FY 2024-2025) on worldwide income, with statutory exclusions for qualifying exported services; the SAS is always a VAT responsible entity; no pass-through treatment is available.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election exists for the SAS; entity-level taxation is mandatory. Available elective regimes: (1) Régimen Simple de Tributación (RST) - consolidating income tax, ICA and parafiscal levies at progressive rates between 2.2% and 14.5% for taxpayers with gross income below 100,000 UVT; (2) Permanent Special Free Zone (Zona Franca Permanente Especial) election - reduced 20% corporate rate for export-oriented service companies meeting DIAN investment and employment criteria; (3) Economía Naranja income-tax exemption under Art. 235-2 ET (up to 7 years) for qualifying creative and localization activities, subject to minimum job creation, local investment and export-intensity conditions as tightened by Ley 2277/2022; (4) hybrid-mismatch alignment and transfer-pricing documentation elections under Decrees 2120/2017 and 1625/2016.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: IVA - Impuesto sobre las Ventas (Value Added Tax), administered by DIAN; cross-border digital services supplied by non-residents are additionally subject to the digital consumption tax regime under Art. 420-ter of the Estatuto Tributario.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: No monetary registration threshold for corporate entities: a SAS must register as an IVA responsible person from its first taxable act in Colombia. Natural persons may remain non-responsible when gross income does not exceed 3,500 UVT (COP 174,296,500 for UVT 2025 = COP 49,799) and they do not engage in import operations (Art. 437 ET). Non-resident digital service providers must register through a local agent when supplying services to Colombian users.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing (Facturación Electrónica de Venta - FE) per Decreto 2242/2015 and Resolución DIAN 000165/2023. Each invoice is generated as XML, transmitted to DIAN's MUISCA webservice for cryptographic validation, and cleared with a unique CUFE/CUDS code and QR stamp before the transaction becomes legally effective; buyers must accept or reject the invoice event chain within 48 hours. Exporters must file the monthly VAT return (Form 300), report export-service income through the Exógena information return (Form 2276), and may claim accumulated export VAT credits through the devolución del IVA procedure (Art. 855 ET).

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Export services qualify for the 0% IVA rate under Art. 481 numeral 3 ET when: (a) the counterparty is a non-domiciled foreign entity; (b) the service (multilingual translation, subtitling, localization QA, media dubbing) is economically consumed outside Colombia; (c) the price is paid from abroad through foreign-currency remittance; and (d) the exporter holds an electronic export invoice and a service contract evidencing foreign use. Back-office services supporting Colombian-source production do not qualify. The resulting VAT credit balance may be refunded monthly or bimonthly through DIAN's export refund procedure.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Electronic export invoice (Factura Electrónica de Exportación) carrying CUFE/CUDS stamp and QR code
Signed localization service agreement with the non-resident client (bilingual version recommended)

Inward Remittance Certificate (Certificado de Reintegro de Divisas) issued by the Colombian FX intermediary, plus Wise B2B or Payoneer settlement statements when payments are received through those rails
Tax-residence certificate (Certificado de Residencia Fiscal) of the foreign beneficiary
Annual Exógena declaration (Form 2276) reporting export-service income
When physical master files or dubbed media are shipped: Customs Export Declaration (Declaración de Exportación/DEX), Bill of Lading or Airway Bill, and packing list
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DIAN cross-matches e-invoices, banking/FX reports and customs data; a missing inward remittance within the 180-day term recharacterizes the zero-rated sale as taxable at 19%. Penalties: monthly moratory interest on the unremitted tax; accuracy penalty of up to 160% of the understated IVA (Art. 648 ET); 20% surcharge for improper refunds (Art. 670 ET); exclusion from the exporter refund regime; and criminal liability for fraudulent zero-rating claims under Art. 436-B of the Código Penal (imprisonment of up to 9 years) plus director disqualification.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banco de la República (Central Bank of Colombia), in coordination with the Ministry of Finance and Public Credit and the National Directorate of Taxes and Customs (DIAN) for trade and service export documentation enforcement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Colombia has a regulated convertible currency regime. Current-account transactions are generally freely convertible but must be channeled through authorized Foreign Exchange Market Intermediaries (IMCs) and reported via the exchange declaration (Declaración de Cambio). Capital-account transactions, including foreign direct investment, require registration with Banco de la República. Profit remittances and dividend transfers are permissible after the related foreign investment has been registered, local taxes have been paid, and the corresponding exchange declaration has been filed. There is no full on-shore capital-account liberalization; non-registered capital inflows and outflows may be blocked, penalized, or treated as illegal exchange operations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: For service exports, including professional multilingual translation, media dubbing, and localization services, the gross proceeds must be settled and channeled into the Colombian foreign exchange market within four (4) months of the service accrual date. In practical terms, 100% of export proceeds must be routed through an authorized IMC in COP or a foreign-currency account legally pre-registered with Banco de la República. No fixed percentage of proceeds needs to be mandatorily converted to Colombian pesos, but the full amount must either enter the local market or remain in a registered foreign-currency account; any retention outside regulated channels constitutes a violation of the exchange regime.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational current account (COP/FCY); temporary FX settlement account for inbound FDI registration
Operational current account (COP/FCY); foreign-investment registration account
Operational current account; enterprise payroll and trade settlement account
Operational current account; cash concentration account for local disbursements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-Medium feasibility as a primary treasury rail. Wise B2B and Payoneer are not authorized Colombian foreign exchange intermediaries and cannot issue exchange declarations, register foreign investment, or provide supporting documentation for capital repatriation. They may be used only as auxiliary collection/payment channels for minor operational amounts, provided all offshore receipts are ultimately routed to a Colombian regulated bank for proper FX settlement. Using a non-regulated EMI for significant cross-border liquidity would create unregistered export proceeds and expose the entity to exchange control penalties.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Colombian banking law does not require all directors to appear physically. However, the entity must maintain a local legal representative in Colombia with physical presence or documented authority to act for the S.A.S. In practice, opening an account requires at least one natural person, typically the legal representative or a formally empowered officer, to attend an in-person or video interview. Fully remote onboarding is permitted only when the bank has adopted remote biometric KYC and the entity has an established local address and tax registration; traditional banks will usually demand an initial physical visit or notarized appointment of a Colombian-based agent.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident majority shareholders with no visible local physical presence.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation (Certificado de Cámara de Comercio), apostilled and notarized board resolutions, official UBO registration (Registro Único de Beneficiarios Finales), sworn statement of ultimate parent structure, and the legal representative's notarized power of attorney.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Newly formed S.A.S. with virtual office address, no payroll, and limited domestic substance.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Executed localization/translation service agreements with named foreign clients, detailed commercial invoices, delivery acceptance evidence, bank statements from supporting professional references, and proof of subcontracting relationships with local dubbing studios if applicable.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Recurring inbound wire transfers through Wise B2B or Payoneer rather than regulated banking channels.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Export proceeds reconciliation report showing each EMI payout, underlying client invoice, and subsequent SWIFT transfer from the EMI to the Colombian IMC; board-approved policy establishing that all export proceeds will be settled through the IMC within the statutory period.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Rapid inbound capital contribution followed by dividend remittance in the same fiscal year.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Foreign investment registration form submitted to Banco de la República, shareholder source-of-wealth and source-of-funds documentation, audited financial statements, certified income tax return (Form 110), and board minutes evidencing the dividend distribution in accordance with the bylaws.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Foreign shareholders must transfer funds via SWIFT to the S.A.S.'s COP account held at an authorized Colombian bank. The receiving bank acts as the IMC and files the exchange declaration under the foreign direct investment purpose code for 'Inversión directa en el país' with Banco de la República. The entity must supply the foreign investor's identification, the local NIT (tax ID), proof of the underlying transaction, and the instruction letter stating the investment purpose. Capital must be registered with Banco de la República within the statutory period (typically within two years) to become eligible for future profits and capital repatriation. Funds received from unrelated third parties without a registered investment purpose are treated as ordinary trade financing or loans and are subject to different reporting rules.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for service imports and operational outflows are executed via SWIFT MT103 through the Colombian IMC. Commercial letters of credit are permissible for purchasing goods and media equipment, but are not common for localization and dubbing services. For services, typical clearing rails include direct SWIFT transfers for foreign contractors, ACH and Redeban for domestic payments to Colombian vendors, and bank-draft collections for one-off royalty or license payments. Outbound payments involving Wise B2B or Payoneer are permitted only as supplementary rails for payments that have already complied with tax withholding and exchange declaration requirements, and they must not replace the regulated IMC settlement channel.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: FX forward contracts (delivery) transacted with authorized IMCs for hedging recognized USD/COP operating exposures
Non-deliverable forwards (NDF) permitted for entities with established underlying trade or investment positions, subject to hedging-purpose validation
FX swaps between USD and COP executed onshore through an authorized intermediary
USD/COP currency options (puts and calls) used solely for hedging committed cross-border payment obligations
Cross-currency interest rate swaps available for long-term liabilities linked to registered foreign investments

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Registry Renewal (Renovación de la Matrícula Mercantil)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs fines up to 2% of net assets per calendar month; failure for two consecutive years triggers cancellation of the commercial registration and administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within five working days after shareholder approval; generally by 30 May of each year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late deposit results in formal admonition, fines, and ineligibility to obtain certificates of good standing; prolonged non-compliance may lead to administrative strike-off.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Return (Declaración de Renta y Complementarios)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: DIAN (Dirección de Impuestos y Aduanas Nacionales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually during April per DIAN's grouping schedule; specific due date published annually by DIAN
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty equal to 5% of tax due per month of delay, capped at 100%; accrual of default interest; additional fine of 1,000 UVT for non-filing.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Ultimate Beneficial Owner Declaration (Declaración de Beneficiarios Finales)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 30 July for the previous calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of 500 UVT (approx. USD 7,000) for omission; additional penalties for false or incomplete information.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory appointment of Revisor Fiscal (independent auditor) if total assets exceed 5,000 Current Monthly Legal Minimum Wages (SMMLV), or gross revenue exceeds 5,000 SMMLV, or workforce exceeds 20 employees; also required when the Superintendencia de Sociedades exercises supervision over the entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Colombian Financial Reporting Framework based on IFRS (NIIF) pursuant to Decreto 2483 de 2018; full IFRS for large entities, IFRS for SMEs for smaller S.A.S.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: All Colombian legal entities must file an annual UBO declaration with DIAN identifying individuals who directly or indirectly own, control, or derive economic benefits from at least 20% of shares, voting rights, or profit participation. The legal representative submits the declaration; any subsequent transfer in majority ownership requires an updated filing.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members (Libro de Registro de Accionistas)
Register of Directors (Libro de Actas de Junta Directiva)
Minute Book (Libro de Actas de Asamblea de Accionistas)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,000–6,000 per certified audit when required
